text: Gorko sooduɗo mo on Misra wi'ani ɓeyngu makko: Teddin jipporde makko nden, moƴƴo-ɗaa e makko; hino gasa ka o nafira en wallitorgol en yoga e golleeji men maa jogitoɗen mo ɓiɗɗo ne'eteeɗo. Ko wano Men daɗndiri non Yuusufa e maayde, Men yaltini mo ka woyndu, Men humindiri ɓernde gorko on e makko; ko non kadi Men hoɗniri mo Misra fii yo Men anndin mo firo koyɗi. Alla non ko fooluɗo e fiyaaku makko on: ɗum ko laatotooɗum, alah firtinoowo Mo. Kono ɓurɓe ɗuuɗuɓe e yimɓe ɓen -woni heeferɓe ɓen- anaadah ɗum.
